# PromptBase

> > The #1 marketplace for AI prompts, connecting prompt creators with buyers across 260,000+ prompts for Midjourney, ChatGPT, Gemini, Veo, and other AI models.

PromptBase is a comprehensive marketplace and platform for discovering, creating, and monetizing AI prompts. It serves as both a buyer's marketplace for premium prompts and a creator platform with tools for prompt engineers, freelancers, and app builders.

## Key Topics

- Midjourney prompts
- ChatGPT image generation
- Gemini Image
- Veo video generation
- AI art generation
- Prompt marketplace
- Prompt engineering
- Commercial-use prompts
- Logo design
- App Builder
- Prompt monetization
- AI freelancers
- Image generation
- Video generation
- Featured prompts

## Core Marketplace

- [AI Prompts | PromptBase: The #1 Marketplace for AI Prompts](https://promptbase.com): PromptBase homepage: #1 marketplace for 260,000+ AI prompts
- [Prompt Marketplace | PromptBase](https://promptbase.com/marketplace): PromptBase marketplace: Browse premium prompts for all AI models
- [PromptBase Select | PromptBase](https://promptbase.com/promptbase-select): PromptBase Select subscription: 10 prompts/month from 200,000+
